svg.title: How a research workspace follows a question
svg.desc: The host chooses four activities and can revisit each one. The server retains sources, decisions and unfinished reading for the next session.
svg.text: From a research question to a handoff
The host agent chooses the next activity. A question can return to any step.
Define the question and its scope.
Build MeSH blocks and name seed articles.
Measure the papers a condition excludes.
Follow citations or inspect a Chronicle branch.
Read the abstract or an accessible passage.
Record its PMID or DOI and the evidence scope.
Connect an interpretation to its sources.
Record alternatives and the next paper to read.
Research workspace · Question, decisions, evidence locators and open actions persist by tenant.
